name: acis-archive-frontend
description: Static frontend for the ACIS Digital Archive. Exists so Amplify's monorepo root detection can read a package.json at frontend/; the site itself has no build step and no dependencies — amplify.yml only substitutes AI_API_URL into js/config.js.

scripts.build: echo 'No build step — static site; amplify.yml handles AI_API_URL substitution.'
